purpose: The dominant narrow-product template: hero + 1-3 benefit sections + testimonial + related-products grid + CTA footer. Confirmed by comparing measured section sequences across 11 of the 17 non-blog product-family routes.
notes: 11 of dt&ai's 17 single-product routes share this exact spine, varying only in the count of benefit-narrative instances (1 on loan-origination/loan-purchase, 2 on ach/ledger/checks/book-transfers/card-programs, 3 on wire/bank-accounts/debt-financing/international-wires).

card-programs uses a differently-named hero component ('Hero__Wrapper' vs '_hero__ProductHero' elsewhere) but the measured content model and layout are identical to hero-product; treated as the same section typeId.
